blocks.section: SEPARATING THE FRONT ENCLOSURE, REAR ENCLOSURE, AND MAIN CHASSIS ASSEMBLY
blocks.content: Using the Phillips screwdriver, remove the screws in the infuser handle, and remove the shoe from the front enclosure.

blocks.section: SEPARATING THE FRONT ENCLOSURE, REAR ENCLOSURE, AND MAIN CHASSIS ASSEMBLY
blocks.content: Carefully place the infuser face up.

blocks.section: SEPARATING THE FRONT ENCLOSURE, REAR ENCLOSURE, AND MAIN CHASSIS ASSEMBLY
blocks.content: Using the flat blade screwdriver, depress the flex tabs that secure the front enclosure while lifting up the front enclosure, and remove the front enclosure.
